checks.command: pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-partner-runtime lint && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-partner-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-partner-runtime test && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-partner-runtime build
checks.proves: Partner finance routes/presentation remain source-clean, typed, tested and buildable after U007 changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove WLT ledger/provider/reconciliation or cross-Partner DB isolation.

checks.proves: WLT payout/COD/settlement/ledger/provider packages pass together on the exact Partner financial candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove app navigation or DSH facade by itself.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted WLT tests exit zero and touched financial state/idempotency/unknown-result branches are covered.
checks.failCriteria: Any targeted test fails or a changed financial branch lacks executable coverage.

checks.proves: DSH Partner self-service finance/COD/payout facades compile and affected authorization tests pass.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove WLT internal balance/ledger correctness unless exercised by WLT tests.
checks.passCriteria: Targeted HTTP tests exit zero and caller-controlled financial identity/destination is not authoritative.
checks.failCriteria: Any target test fails or cross-Partner/caller-controlled financial authority is possible.

checks.proves: Repository guards detect no DSH/frontend financial ownership violation or broken full-stack boundary after Partner finance changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Static guards do not prove ledger reconciliation/provider outcomes.
checks.failCriteria: Any financial ownership/full-stack boundary violation is reported.

checks.command: pnpm openapi:compose:wlt && pnpm openapi:compose:dsh && pnpm guard:api-binding && pnpm guard:contract-registry-drift
checks.proves: WLT/DSH Partner finance contracts, generated consumers and registry bindings remain aligned.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove runtime financial transitions.
checks.failCriteria: Contract composition, API binding or registry drift fails.

checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; pnpm runtime:wlt:migrate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; foreach ($test in @("services/wlt/database/tests/cod-custody-invariants.sql","services/wlt/database/tests/payout-destination-invariants.sql","services/wlt/database/tests/settlement-commission-invariants.sql")) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $test -Raw | docker compose --env-file infra/docker/env/runtime.env.example -f infra/docker/compose.runtime.yml exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U bthwani_runtime -d wlt_runtime; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; node --test services/wlt/tests/wlt-database-authority.test.mjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE'
checks.proves: Governed WLT migrations plus Partner-relevant COD/payout/settlement invariants and database-authority checks pass on local PostgreSQL.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not grant finance approval or production provider evidence.
checks.passCriteria: Migration, all SQL invariant suites and database-authority test exit zero.

checks.command: pnpm runtime:full:smoke && pnpm runtime:wiremock:financial:smoke && pnpm runtime:wlt:provider:smoke
checks.proves: Governed integration runtime and financial simulator/provider-through-WLT path are healthy for payout/unknown-result/reconciliation scenarios.
checks.doesNotProve: Smoke alone does not prove every Partner actor/idempotency scenario unless scenario evidence executes it.
checks.passCriteria: All runtime/provider commands exit zero before scenario evidence is recorded.
checks.failCriteria: Required service/provider simulation or WLT provider path fails.

checks.proves: Enumerates every current Partner finance/COD entry and current payout semantics for final duplicate/dead-path review.
checks.doesNotProve: Search does not establish runtime reachability or money correctness alone.
checks.passCriteria: Every live Partner finance entry is intentional and WLT-backed; no unexplained beneficiary destination mutation, stale/parallel finance writer or overlapping COD model remains.
checks.failCriteria: A contradictory/dead live path, DSH/frontend monetary writer, beneficiary destination mutation or unexplained overlapping COD model is found.
